BiblicalUsage: Jeziah is named once, in Ezra 10:25. In Ezra 10:25 we read, "Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jeziah is part of the family history Scripture preserves, and I believe those lists are not filler.
